description:
Activate Vault of Whispers by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Vault of Whispers to become a creature until end of turn.
Vault of Whispers dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Vault of Whispers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
